title: Chapter 928
text:
As the last piece of the puzzle was completed, the world in front of him seemed to have undergone a subtle change, and his perception of space had undergone a transformation.

Han Xiao raised his head and looked at the cup on the table. All sorts of functions and formulas seemed to have appeared at the corners of the cup, and after removing the superfluous appearance, only precise lines were left to outline the spatial structure of the cup. Looking around, the same thing happened to all the items in the room. Everything in the room had more than one form of existence in the spatial structure.

After blinking his eyes, this perception slowly dissipated, and his vision returned to normal.

"This is the change brought about by [Hyperspace Thinking]. It has raised my spatial perception to a whole new level."

Han Xiao calmed himself down. The feeling just now was as if he was maintaining the perspective of multiple dimensions at the same time.

[Hyperspace Theory] only provided one talent, but the effect was very impressive. It increased his mobility and control skills, as well as some mental resistance. The other two talents were important talents that came from learning all the knowledge.

Normally, players would not be able to afford the cost of all the class knowledges, so it would be very difficult for them to learn all of them. However, the Liver Emperor was not an ordinary person. In the later versions of his previous life, there were also Mechanics who had learned all the knowledge, and Han Xiao was one of them. Thus, he was not unfamiliar with the powerful effects of these two talents.

"With these two talents, my strength has increased by a level. I can be considered a complete high-level Mechanic."

Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. He secretly estimated that the strengthened [Ultimate Knowledge Holder] and the newly added [Omnipotent Mechanic] had increased his strength by a level. His strength under normal conditions had already reached the level after activating [Perfect Mechanical Sense].

The higher his Machinery Affinity, the greater the increase in the Mechanical Sense talent. As long as he completely obtained [Perfect Mechanical Sense], everything would be complete!

At that time, his Mechanic class abilities would only be lacking a Unique Talent compared to [Mechanic Emperor] Manison, and the difference would not be too far.

"Now that I've obtained all the Class Knowledges, all that's left is to level up the Knowledges." Han Xiao smiled.

In his previous life, there might have been players who had learned all the knowledge, but no one had ever maxed out all the knowledge. This was Han Xiao's goal. To achieve this, he would need a huge amount of EXP. The EXP he had accumulated in this version was far from enough. He could only continue working hard in the next version.

In his previous life, no one had ever accomplished this feat, so Han Xiao did not know if there would be any additional rewards if he maxed out all his class knowledges. No matter what, there was a huge player market. Maxing out all his class knowledges was a path that he had to take. It was definitely a profitable one.

There were also an additional 500 Free Attribute Points in his interface. Han Xiao looked at his own attributes. His Intelligence had finally broken through the ten thousand mark. Intelligence was the main attribute of a Mechanic. It was related to the attributes of machinery, the power of Mechanical Force bonuses, the efficiency of machinery control, and the damage output of machinery. Currently, he did not lack Endurance. He was so tanky that even he could not stand it. Han Xiao continued to add all his points into Intelligence.

After looking at his attributes twice, Han Xiaoxin was satisfied. He closed the interface and ate two highly concentrated nutrition bars to celebrate. He then took a private spaceship and came to one of the satellites in the headquarters alone. He found an empty large open-air training ground, opened the secondary dimensional army box, and released all the Mechanical Lives.

After many years of accumulation, Han Xiao now had more than a hundred thousand Mechanical Lives under his command. More than ten Apostle Weapons were the leaders, and they lined up in front of Han Xiao.

In the huge square, there were all kinds of mechanical lives. They stopped playing and looked at Han Xiao. Those with legs knelt on one knee, and those without legs lowered their heads to show respect. It was a grand scene.

"Lord."

"Get up." Han Xiao raised his hand, looked at Psionic Prime, and said with a deep voice, "The time has come. The Mechanical Civilization Plan I mentioned can be implemented now."

"I will not disappoint the Lord." Psionic Prime's mechanical facial features showed a determined expression.

Han Xiao raised his finger, and a virtual screen appeared in the sky, showing the star map of the Garu Star Cluster. The image was quickly enlarged and locked onto a planet in one of the Star Systems. It was located in his territory.

"This planet will be your new home in the future. It has rich ores and metal resources. Psionic Prime, you can stay there with all the Mechanical Lives to develop. I will have the army provide you with resources. I only have one request for you, and that is to expand as much as possible and increase your population."

Because he wanted to develop his Mechanical Civilization, Han Xiao released all the Mechanical Lives. They did not need to stay in the secondary dimensional army box for the time being.

After being modified by [Tinder Awakening], the Mechanical Lives were no longer inanimate objects. Their bodies were filled with silicon-based nerve fibers, and they had independent thoughts. At the same time, they also had the ability to reproduce.

The reproduction method of the Mechanical Lives was not clanking but asexual reproduction. Two or more Mechanical Lives would extract their own tinder genetic code and pass it on to the assembly line or carefully assembled Mechanical Lives to 'incubate' newborns. After a long period of energy supply, the tinder of the newborns would be strengthened and they would grow into complete Mechanical Lives.

The Mechanical Lives created through this method of reproduction would share the life energy of the first generation Mechanical Lives. The purity and basic attributes of the 'bloodline' would naturally be far inferior to the first generation Mechanical Lives. The first generation Mechanical Lives that completed reproduction would also enter a period of weakness due to the huge consumption of their source energy.

However, the advantage was that they could mass-produce newborns, and Han Xiao did not need to spend a lot of effort to convert them. The production efficiency would increase by millions of times. Even the weakest Mechanical Life would have a much higher growth rate than mechanical soldiers. This was also the original intention of developing the Mechanical Civilization — to form a large-scale arsenal.

Manison had the Mechanical Civilization that had been developed for many years as an army camp, and there would be an endless supply of soldiers.

With these 100,000 Mechanical Lives, as long as they develop for a few years, I will be able to have a new Mechanical Life army … Han Xiao thought to himself.

All the Mechanical Lives looked up at the virtual screen. Looking at the 3D projection of this planet, there was a commotion.

"I will not disappoint you." Psionic Prime retracted his gaze and simulated a solemn tone.

"Hmm, recommend another person with outstanding abilities. I will give him the slot to create an Apostle Weapon." Han Xiao smiled.

The two new talents gave him a + 3 bonus to his Mechanical Skills, which meant that he had three more slots for [Apostle Life Creation]. He could create new Apostle Weapons. Letting Psionic Prime choose one of them was to help him solidify his position as the leader.

Han Xiao would not keep an eye on the development of the Mechanical Civilization, so he needed Psionic Prime to manage it for him. The stronger his position as the spokesperson, the smoother the development of the Mechanical Civilization would be.

Hearing that, Psionic Prime raised his spear and pointed behind him. "Heaven-Suppressing Banner, come out."

Han Xiao looked in the direction the spear was pointing at and saw a huge Mechanical Life covered in heavy armor walk out from the crowd. It seemed to be wearing battle armor, and there were all kinds of weapons on its body. It had six arms, one on its shoulders, one on its back, and one on its waist. There was a huge alloy shield on its back that looked like a huge black flag.

"He's the bravest warrior in our race who's best at fighting. He defeated hundreds of our people and took all kinds of weapons. At the same time, he also knows how to lead an army. He's very outstanding. Your Excellency, please grant him the right to become an Apostle," Psionic Prime said.

Han Xiao sized up the Heaven-Suppressing Banner. The various mechanical equipment on this fellow were the spoils of war that he obtained from defeating his opponents.

These Mechanical Lives all had very high growth rates. With the blessing of [Machinery Fusion — Grant], they were able to modify their own hardware structure. Many of the functions of these Mechanical Lives were no longer limited to the mechanical models before they were awakened.

"You have the right to become my Apostle. Use this power well." Han Xiao raised his hand, and a bright golden Mechanical Force appeared on his palm like a thundercloud.

With a flip of his hand, this Mechanical Force shot into the Heaven-Suppressing Banner's body, modifying it and creating a new Apostle.

Han Xiao did not look at the transformation process of the Heaven-Suppressing Banner and turned to Psionic Prime. "I'll leave the command of the Mechanical Lives to you for the time being. Help me do something first."

…

Planet Black Spirit.

After being modified by the Evolution Cube a few years ago, the current Black Spirit Race was even more intelligent and agile. They had gained visual senses and gradually got used to living on the ground, no longer living in their nests. Under the highly efficient command of the mental network, they built stone cities one after another.

The largest stone city belonged to the Germinal Tribe. In the middle of the city was a tall stone statue that was the sculpture of Black Star. At this moment, a metal cylinder was placed at the top of the statue. It was the Evolutionary Totem.

An endless stream of evolution energy radiated out. To species with room for evolution, the totem was extremely effective. The evolution process of the Black Spirit Race was condensed hundreds of times. The current appearance of the Black Spirit Race was different from a few years ago. The proportion of their shells to their bodies had shrunk again, and the characteristics of insects and beasts had decreased greatly. Furthermore, a portion of the Black Spirit Race gradually stopped crawling and stood upright. Although their backs were still very hunched, they already had the embryonic form of an upright creature.

Their forelimbs gradually played the role of palms, and they began to learn how to use tools.

Until now, Han Xiao had not advanced the civilization of the Black Spirit Race. He was more focused on improving the quality of the Black Spirit Race. The way he saw it, as long as the race itself was perfected, it would be much easier to help the Black Spirit Race develop.

The racial characteristic of the Black Spirit Race was the mental communication network, which increased the efficiency of communication and the spread of knowledge. The racial potential leaned toward the mind, and the totem subtly increased the mental power of the entire race.

The reproductive ability of the Black Spirit Race was also very strong. After more than a decade of reproduction, they had already given birth to a few generations of newborns, and their population had increased by a lot.

At this moment, in the center of the Germinal Tribe, a large group of young Black Spirit Race members were playing around an adult. This adult was the leader of the Germinal Tribe.

The current leader of the Germinal Tribe was wearing a crude animal skin robe and holding a simple scepter made of Prophecy Stone in his hand. This was completely different from the other members of the Black Spirit Race. Most of them did not wear clothes.

After being modified by the Evolution Cube a few years ago, the Black Spirit Race had given birth to a very small number of mutants that could build a mental communication network on their own and replace the Prophecy Stone as the server. Thus, these mutants had obtained very high status in the race and were respectfully called 'Sages'.

The leader of the Germinal Tribe was the strongest mutant among them, and his mental network could accommodate the most individuals. At the same time, he was the spokesperson of the 'Black Star God', so he was called the 'Great Sage' by his people.

"Great Sage, why do we have to worship the Black Star God?" A group of young Black Spirit Race members surrounded the leader of the Germinal Tribe and chattered in the mental network.

The leader of the Germinal Tribe tapped his scepter on the ground, and with a serious expression, he fervently built up faith for his descendants. "Black Star God brought us the gospel of evolution, the fire of our civilization. He is an omnipotent existence."

"I don't believe it. I feel that the Great Sage is more powerful than the Black Star God." A group of young Black Spirit Race members laughed.

"Humph, you know nothing about power." The leader of the Germinal Tribe used his scepter to point at a battleship floating in the sky. "Do you see that? That thing is called a spaceship. It is the one that brought us here from our distant homeland. If we relied on ourselves, we would not be able to return even after ten million years. However, the spaceships owned by the Black Star God can fill the entire sky and tear apart the solid ground in an instant. That is the true power of a god."

"Homeland? Isn't this our homeland? "

"Sigh, our homeland has long been taken away. If not for the Black Star God bringing us away, perhaps we would have already …"

The leader of the Germinal Tribe sighed and shook his head.

At this time, hundreds of small black dots appeared in the blue sky. They were all spaceships, and they slowly stopped above the Germinal Tribe. Instantly, it caused a commotion among the Black Spirit Race. Many of them gathered in the square and looked up at the descending spaceships.

The cabin door opened, and Psionic Prime flew out and landed in front of the leader of the Germinal Tribe. The surrounding Black Spirit Race members dispersed, but they were not nervous.

In their eyes, these metal creatures were the servants of the Black Star God.

"I am the Chief Apostle of the Lord. The Black Star God ordered me to bring you away from this planet."

The leader of the Germinal Tribe stood up and spoke with his voice that had yet to fully evolve.

"Where is the Black Star God bringing us?"

"A new homeland."

…

With the investment of a large number of financial groups, the Black Star Corps had sufficient funds to purchase large amounts of construction equipment and prepare for the construction of the army. The process was very smooth, and there were no setbacks.

After preparing for almost a month, under the attention of the entire universe, the construction team of the army finally set off, bringing manpower and resources to the construction site in the Flickering World.

Lagi, Reynold, Sylvia, and Herlous were in charge of the construction work. Han Xiao was only responsible for remote supervision because he had to hide in the dynasty for a while. He had already left behind the blueprint of the construction site, so there was no need for him to be there personally.

On the day the construction team of the Black Star Corps set off, Han Xiao arrived at the stargate to the Central Galaxy. Only Aurora and a group of Black Star Guards accompanied him.

On one hand, this trip was to hide for a while. On the other hand, Han Xiao also planned to visit the various Beyond Grade A allies of the dynasty. After all, he would have to deal with them for many years to come, so it was a good opportunity to get closer to them.

At the same time, he was also prepared to meet all the famous people of the dynasty in the future.

After the version update, the middle-level authority of the dynasty would undergo a new iteration. He still had a long way to go before working with the dynasty, so he had to look further. For the sake of the future, he had to build a good relationship with the powerful people in the future and make a long-term plan for the future.

Glancing at Fu Ding and the others, Han Xiao turned to look at Aurora in the pilot's seat and nodded.

"Let's go."

Hearing that, Aurora swiped her finger on the control screen, and the spaceship slowly entered the stargate.

At the same time, Ames and Hella's spaceship also arrived at the stargate at the edge of the Shattered Star Ring.

Looking back in the direction of the Shattered Star Ring, Hella had complicated feelings.

She had a feeling that she would not be able to return for a long time.

Beyond Grade A …

At this moment, a slender hand pressed on her shoulder. Hella looked up and saw Ames smiling at her.

"Let's go."

"Phew … got it."

Hella put away her thoughts, pushed the control stick, and the spaceship disappeared into the stargate vortex.
